stem: The masses of a certain variety of plums are known to have standard deviation 13.2 g. A random sample of 200 of these plums is taken and the mean mass of the plums in the sample is found to be 62.3 g.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Calculate a 98% confidence interval for the population mean mass.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: State with a reason whether it was necessary to use the Central Limit theorem in the calculation in part **(i)**.
